about: Shared case table for the placement map (contract/placements.json). Every reader runs every row. readCases: reading the map file and resolving names against it; publishable says whether the strict schema accepts the file (a builder publishes only such files), read and resolve are what a tolerant reader does. sourceCases: which map a reader uses (network, last known, bundled) and with which status. showingCases: what a placement draws once its document has been loaded. Limits on the number of placements and on the published file size are publish-side only and are not rows here. The groups after showingCases are the reader rules settled after the reader audit. bodyCases: the BYTES of a map body as a reader receives them; body is a list of parts joined in order, each part is either text (encoded as UTF-8) or hex (raw bytes, two lowercase digits per byte), repeated times times (default 1); read and resolve are as in readCases. transportCases: how an HTTP answer to the map request or to the placement document request is sorted; times are milliseconds from the start of the request, headersAtMs is when the status arrives (default completedAtMs), completedAtMs is when the body ends (null: never). Document rows carry no body: a reader under test answers 2xx with any readable document. Expected for the map is the kind of the network outcome (map, corrupt, notModified, notFound, offline); for the document it is read (handed to the document reader), missing or unreadable. eventCases: settled states of one placement in order and the events the host hears; there is an event for every change of status, report, mapStatus, documentId or entry, the first settled state included. cacheCases: steps of one reader on placement home.banner of two projects (a, b) whose map and document addresses differ only in the project; map is the network outcome of the map request (the map names document d1), document is how the request for d1 ended (ok, notFound, offline); the last known map is kept per map address, and a document that answered 404 is never shown from memory again. scheduleCases (placement contract 1.1.0): a placement with a schedule, resolved at the instant now. json or text is the map as in readCases; publishable is what the strict schema together with the publish rule accepts; shapeOnly marks rows the JSON Schema of the artifact accepts and only the publish rule (until later than from, no overlapping windows in one placement) rejects; problems are the publish problems in the order of placement names. Each check names a placement and an instant now (UTC, whole seconds); status, documentId and entry are what the placement shows at that instant (a scheduled item with documentId null is a pause: the placement is empty for its window), and next is the earliest boundary (a from or an until of a readable scheduled item) later than now, or null.

no placements at all
publishedAt in UTC is part of the published form
malformed publishedAt: not publishable, but a reader does not look at it
unknown top-level field: not publishable, ignored by a reader
unknown field in a placement: not publishable, ignored by a reader
newer minor of the same major is read
another major (newer) is not understood
another major (older) is not understood
version missing
version that is not MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
version with a leading zero is not a version
version as a number
placements missing
placements as an array
placements null
the file is JSON null
the file is a JSON array
the file is a JSON string
text that is not JSON (an HTML error page from a proxy)
empty text
truncated JSON text
valid JSON text
__proto__ as a placement name is not a placement and does not touch the others
__proto__ at the top level is an unknown field
a placement may be called constructor; it is found only when it is in the map
name forms: segments after the first may hold a hyphen and start with a digit
names of the wrong form are in the file, but no reader finds them
a documentId that would leave the documents folder makes only its placement unreadable
documentId forms: dots inside, mixed case, underscores and the 64-character limit
documentId of the wrong type or length

sourceCases.name: a readable map from the network is used and remembered
the network wins over the last known map
a fresh map without the placement is the answer: no fallback to an older map
a broken placement in a fresh map is unreadable; no fallback for one placement
304 Not Modified keeps the last known map, and it is fresh
304 without a last known map counts as no answer
304 with an unreadable last known map and nothing bundled
no answer: the last known map first
no answer and no last known map: the bundled copy
no answer and nothing to fall back on
an unreadable last known map is skipped for the bundled copy
a last known map of another major is skipped for the bundled copy
the network answered with something that is not a map: corrupt, last known map used and kept
corrupt answer and only a bundled copy
corrupt answer and nothing to fall back on
a map of another major from the network: unsupported, last known map used
another major and nothing to fall back on
404: never published and nothing to fall back on, so every placement is unknown
404 with a bundled copy: the copy shipped with the app
404 with a last known map: the same fallback order as any other failure
404 with an unreadable bundled copy: no map, and the placements are unknown

showingCases.name: a document without an entry starts on its initial screen
a document with an entry it has
an entry the document no longer has: initial screen, and the host is told
an entry and a document with no entry points
the document is gone (404 after the document's own fallbacks)
the document is gone, no entry asked
an empty placement draws nothing and tells the host
an unknown placement draws nothing and tells the host
an unreadable placement draws nothing and tells the host

bodyCases.name: the same map without a byte order mark
a UTF-8 byte order mark before the map is skipped
two byte order marks: the second one is not JSON
a byte order mark after leading whitespace is not skipped
a byte that is never UTF-8 (ff) in an unknown field spoils the whole map, it is not replaced
an overlong encoding of a slash (c0 af) in a documentId is corrupt, not a path and not a replacement character
an encoded surrogate (ed a0 80) is not UTF-8
a sequence cut short (e2 82) inside a string is not UTF-8
a code point above U+10FFFF (f4 90 80 80) is not UTF-8
a body in UTF-16 with its byte order mark is not UTF-8
valid two-, three- and four-byte sequences in an unknown field are read
32 nested arrays and objects (the root counts as one) are read
33 levels in an unknown field make the map corrupt
33 levels inside one placement make the whole map corrupt, not only that placement
33 levels of objects count the same as arrays
brackets inside strings, escaped quotes included, are not nesting
an escaped backslash ends the string before the quote, so the brackets after it count
a body of exactly 262144 bytes is read
one byte over 262144 is corrupt
the byte order mark counts toward the size limit
a major of twenty digits is another major
a major that wraps to 1 in 64 bits (2^64 + 1) is another major
a major that wraps to 1 in 32 bits (2^32 + 1) is another major
a major that a double rounds to a power of ten is another major
a minor of twenty digits is read
a patch of twenty digits is read

map: a 308 redirect is not followed and is no answer

map: 404 after 20 s is no answer

map: 200 over the size limit is a corrupt map
map: 200 with a byte order mark is the map
document: 200 that ends in time goes to the document reader
document: headers in time but the body ends after 20 s is unreadable

document: a 307 redirect is not followed and is unreadable
document: a 308 redirect is not followed and is unreadable

eventCases.name: the first settled state is told, even a document with nothing to report
the same state again is not told
a placement that comes back is told: status document, report null
an entry point lost and found again is told both ways
the map going offline while the same document stays is told
another document in the same placement is told
one reason for nothing changing into another is told
a document disappearing and coming back is told every time

cacheCases.name: the last known map of one project is never used for another
a document that answered 404 is never shown from memory afterwards
a document remembered for one project is not shown for another with the same id

scheduleCases.name: a scheduled document replaces the permanent one while its window lasts, from included and until excluded
summer time: until 30 June included in Kyiv is 1 July 00:00 Kyiv, which is 30 June 21:00 UTC
an empty permanent placement shows a document only during the window
the permanent entry is kept outside the window and the scheduled entry inside it
a queue a month ahead: adjacent windows in any array order, one ends exactly when the next starts
windows in different placements may overlap
overlapping windows are not published; a reader shows the one that started later
the later start wins whatever the array order
two windows with the same start: the earlier in the array wins
a window inside another: the inner one while it lasts, then the outer one again; each overlap names the first earlier window
until equal to from is not published, never shows and gives no boundary
until before from is not published and never shows; the other windows still work
an instant with an offset instead of Z is not an instant: that item is skipped, the others work
fractional seconds, a missing second, a lowercase z and a space are not instants
a day that is not in the calendar is not an instant: 29 February of a common year, 31 April, month 13, hour 24, second 60
years outside 2000 to 2099, a date without time, a number and an empty string are not instants
29 February of a leap year and the last second of a year are instants
a scheduled item without a document or with a path for an id is skipped
a bad entry skips the item; entry null in an item is the same as no entry but is not published
an item that is not an object is skipped
an unknown field in an item is ignored by a reader and not published
schedule that is an object is no schedule: the permanent content, no boundary
schedule that is null is no schedule: the permanent content, no boundary
schedule that is a string is no schedule: the permanent content, no boundary
an empty schedule is not published; a reader reads it as no schedule
broken permanent content makes the placement unreadable even while a window lasts
a placement that is not in the map, or a name of the wrong form, is unknown and has no boundary
a map labelled 1.0.0 with a schedule is read with the schedule
a map that cannot be read: every placement is unreadable and has no boundary
a map of another major: unreadable, no boundary
a pause over a permanent document: the placement is empty for the weekend, then the document is back
a pause over a permanent empty placement changes nothing but still has boundaries
a pause next to a scheduled document: the sale, then the weekend pause, then the permanent document
a pause that overlaps a scheduled document is not published; a reader lets the later start win
a pause with an entry is not published; a reader ignores the entry, even a broken one, and pauses
a pause with broken instants or a missing document key is skipped like any broken item
broken permanent content stays unreadable during a pause
